claims.text: Notices go to the other Party's address or e-mail address as set out below its signature on the Agreement, or to any other address that Party has notified under the clause. The actual addresses are not in the provided sources.

citations.quote: sent to the address or e-mail address of the other Party as set out below its signature of this Agreement, or such other address or email address as shall have been notified to the other Party in accordance with this provision.

claims.text: Notices must be in writing and in English.

citations.quote: Any notice required under this Agreement shall be given in writing, in the English language

claims.text: Permitted delivery methods are registered post or equivalent, facsimile, courier, or electronic transmission.

citations.quote: Notices shall be sent by registered post or equivalent, facsimile, courier or by electronic transmission.

claims.text: A notice sent by post is deemed received five working days after posting, or ten working days after posting if the addressee is outside the sender's country.

citations.quote: If posted, the notice shall be deemed to have been received five (5) working days after the date of posting or, in the case of a notice to an addressee not in the country of the sender, ten (10) working days after the date of posting.

claims.text: A notice sent by facsimile or electronic transmission is deemed received when the intended receiving Party confirms complete receipt, and a couriered notice is deemed received on delivery.

citations.quote: If sent by facsimile or electronic transmission, notice shall be deemed received upon confirmation of complete receipt being given by the intended receiving Party. If couriered, notice will be deemed to have been received on delivery.
